title: NEB Class 11 Physics — Dispersion — 2023
subject: physics
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: Derive the relation between angle of incidence, angle of emergence, angle of the prism and angle of deviation for a ray passing through a prism.
questions.solution:
Consider a prism of refracting angle $A$. The ray bends at the first face through $\delta_1$ and at the second face through $\delta_2$.

**Step 1 — Geometry inside the prism** gives:
$$\delta_1 = i - r_1, \qquad \delta_2 = e - r_2$$

**Step 2 — Total deviation:**
$$\delta = \delta_1 + \delta_2 = (i - r_1) + (e - r_2) = i + e - (r_1 + r_2)$$

**Step 3 — For a prism, the two refractions at its faces are complementary to the prism angle:**
$$r_1 + r_2 = A$$

**Step 4 — Substitute:**
$$\boxed{\delta = i + e - A}\quad\text{or}\quad \boxed{i + e = A + \delta}$$

**Condition for minimum deviation:** When $i = e$ (ray passes symmetrically), $2i = A + \delta_{min}$ and $r_1 = r_2 = \dfrac{A}{2}$.
questions.knowledgeNote: For a prism the total deviation is i + e minus A, and minimum deviation occurs when the ray passes symmetrically.
